items.question: If I start a Georgia Tech first-year application but never submit it, can I get the fee back? How much is the fee for domestic and international applicants?
items.gold_answer: The first-year application fee is non-refundable: $75 for domestic applicants and $85 for international applicants. Paying without submitting does not make it refundable.

items.question: Where does Georgia Tech send a refund from my student account—is it mailed as a paper check?
items.gold_answer: The Bursar processes student-account refunds by EFT/direct deposit to the student's checking or savings account.

items.question: Can a Georgia Tech student organization charter a campus bus, and how far ahead does it need to reserve one?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Georgia Tech student organizations and departments may charter buses within metro Atlanta, and reservations must be made at least one week in advance.
items.gold_locator: charter bus eligibility and reservation lead time

items.question: At Georgia Tech, how many semester credits count as full-time, part-time, and less-than-part-time?
items.gold_answer: At least 12 credits is full-time, 6–11 credits is part-time, and 1–5 credits is less-than-part-time for all terms and students.

items.question: I'm a Georgia Tech junior with a 3.0 GPA. Can I take a graduate-level course if the department approves it?
items.gold_answer: No. An undergraduate must have department permission, a minimum 2.7 GPA, and senior classification, then obtain the required permits.

items.question: I'm a Georgia Tech alum considering a K-12 teaching career. Is pre-teaching advising only for current undergrads?
items.gold_answer: No. Pre-Teaching Advising supports undergraduates, graduate students, postdocs, and alumni considering K-12 education careers.

items.question: After I enroll at Georgia Tech, can I still take an AP or IB exam later and receive course credit for it?
items.gold_answer: No. AP, SAT II, IB, and A-Level examinations used for credit must be completed before the student's Georgia Tech enrollment date.

items.question: How long can Georgia Tech take to let me inspect my education records after it receives my FERPA request?
items.gold_answer: FERPA gives the student the right to inspect and review education records within 45 days after Georgia Tech receives the request.
